metabolic_screening.label: Newborn Metabolic Screening (blood spot)
metabolic_screening.program: Ohio Department of Health Newborn Screening Program
metabolic_screening.opt_out_form_label: Religious Objection to Newborn Screening Form
metabolic_screening.state_form_system: ODH provides the Religious Objection to Screening Form; must be signed by parent/guardian and kept in newborn's medical record. Ohio Revised Code 3701.505 — religious objection is the only valid reason for refusal.
metabolic_screening.midwife_role: Collect blood spot at -¥24h and <5 days of age; if religious objection, ensure signed objection form is in newborn's record before discharge.
metabolic_screening.declination_law: ORC 3701.505 — religious objection is the only recognized reason for refusing newborn screening.

hearing_screening.label: Newborn Hearing Screening
hearing_screening.program: Ohio Department of Health Infant Hearing Program
hearing_screening.opt_out_form_label: Objection to Universal Newborn Hearing Screening (HEA 4633)
hearing_screening.state_form_note: Separate hearing screening objection form (HEA 4633). Religious objection is the only valid reason per ORC 3701.505.
hearing_screening.midwife_role: Educate parents; if objection, ensure signed form is in record; arrange follow-up outpatient hearing screening if needed.
hearing_screening.law: ORC 3701.505; HEA 4633 for hearing-specific objection form.

cchd_screening.label: CCHD Pulse Oximetry Screening
cchd_screening.program: Ohio Department of Health — Critical Congenital Heart Disease Screening
cchd_screening.state_form_note: No standalone CCHD declination form — CCHD screening is part of the overall newborn screening process. Refusal documented via the Religious Objection to Screening Form (covers all screening components).
cchd_screening.midwife_role: Perform pulse ox at 24–48h or refer; document refusal in medical record using the ODH Religious Objection form.

erythromycin_eye_ointment.label: Erythromycin Eye Ointment (newborn eye prophylaxis)
erythromycin_eye_ointment.state_form_note: No standalone state declination form — documented via the Religious Objection to Screening Form (covers all screening components). ORC §3701.501 requires eye prophylaxis; religious objection is the sole exception.
erythromycin_eye_ointment.midwife_role: If declining: ensure signed Religious Objection form in record. If administering: apply within 1h of birth.
erythromycin_eye_ointment.law: ORC §3701.501 — eye prophylaxis required; religious objection exception per §3701.505.

vitamin_k.label: Vitamin K (oral or injection)
vitamin_k.midwife_role: Three-way informed choice (oral / shot / none) documented in medical record; midwife administers injection if chosen.

hepatitis_b_vaccine.label: Hepatitis B Vaccine (birth dose)
hepatitis_b_vaccine.program: Ohio Department of Health — Immunization Program
hepatitis_b_vaccine.midwife_role: Birth-dose consent or declination documented in writing; report to Ohio Immunization Program (OHIP).

gestational_diabetes.label: Gestational Diabetes Screening (prenatal)
gestational_diabetes.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice; midwife refers out for glucose testing when declined.

group_b_strep.label: Group B Strep Screening & Prophylaxis (prenatal)
group_b_strep.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice per ACOG/CDC; swab testing via referral or in-office; intrapartum antibiotics referred if opted-in.
